description: Prompt and seed configuration for identity-preserving 2D image generation

prompts.prompt: Create a high-quality 2D anime-style portrait based on the provided reference face. Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hairstyle, and distinctive facial features.
prompts.negative_prompt: photorealistic, distorted face, deformed eyes, extra facial features, blurry, low quality

prompts.prompt: Create a high-quality 2D cartoon portrait based on the provided reference face. Preserve the person's identity and distinctive facial features while applying a clean cartoon illustration style.
prompts.negative_prompt: photorealistic, distorted face, deformed eyes, extra facial features, blurry, low quality

prompts.prompt: Create a high-quality 2D digital illustration based on the provided reference face. Preserve the person's identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, and recognizable features.
prompts.negative_prompt: photorealistic, distorted face, deformed eyes, extra facial features, blurry, low quality
